about: Jellyfin 12.4 (jellyfin/jellyfin:12.4, jellyfin-ffmpeg) PlaybackInfo replies for HEVC and AV1 fixtures under three DeviceProfiles, with the body jellyfin-web sends (IsPlayback, AutoOpenLiveStream, AudioStreamIndex "1", SubtitleStreamIndex "-1", MaxStreamingBitrate 1440987881). Fixtures: 20 s, 640x360, 24 fps, keyframe every 72 frames, AC3 audio in MKV and AAC in MP4. Ids, tokens and session ids are placeholders.

deviceProfileNotes.chrome: jellyfin-web 12.4 in Chrome 154, from transcode-12.4.json: no HEVC, AV1 in direct play and HLS.
deviceProfileNotes.hevc-client: chrome plus hevc in the mp4 and mkv direct-play profiles, in the fMP4 HLS transcoding profile, and hevc profile main|main 10 up to level 183 (a client with a hardware HEVC decoder).
deviceProfileNotes.hevc-direct-only: hevc-client, but the fMP4 HLS transcoding profile lists h264 only.
